en: Only before and after views are available here; they do not show the fitting process or establish long-term performance.
zh: 此处只有维修前后照片，未展示安装过程，也不能确定长期性能。

en: Matching tile or grout appearance is assessed rather than promised.
We check the existing tile and grout finish and discuss compatible materials and the appearance of the repaired area.
zh: 瓷砖或勾缝外观匹配需评估，不作保证。
我们会检查现有瓷砖和砖缝饰面，与您讨论适配材料及修复区域的外观效果。

en: it does not establish the cause of your leak.
we inspect your shower to identify the leak source and the repairs needed.
zh: 该案例不能确定您的漏水原因。
我们会检查您的淋浴区域，查明漏水来源及所需维修。

en: Colour matching can help select a coating but cannot promise that aged surfaces will blend invisibly.
We check colour, sheen and the condition of the existing coating, then discuss a local touch-up or repainting a larger area.
zh: 配色有助于选涂层，但不能保证旧表面无痕融合。
我们会检查颜色、光泽及现有涂层状况，再与您讨论局部补漆或扩大涂刷范围。

en: an exact match is not assumed.
we discuss the expected finish with you before starting.
zh: 不能默认完全匹配。
我们会在施工前与您确认预期饰面效果。

en: An exact match is not assumed.
We confirm the preparation and painting area in your quote.
zh: 不能假定补痕会消失。
并说明修补区域和周边饰面的衔接方式。

en: so agree the desired finish rather than assuming a patch will disappear.
so we discuss the finish you want and set out the repair and painting area in your quote.
zh: 因此需商定期望饰面，
因此我们会与您讨论期望饰面，

en: an exact match should not be assumed.
we explain the preparation and finish options before work begins.
zh: 评估会确认墙面区域及预期饰面；
我们会确认墙面维修区域、基层处理和饰面方案；

en: Existing paint information can help, but an invisible match is not assumed.
We use any existing paint information to discuss colour, sheen and the painting area with you.
zh: 现有油漆资料可能有帮助，但不能预设完全看不出色差。
我们会参考现有油漆资料，与您讨论颜色、光泽及涂刷区域。

en: An older paver match depends on supply and condition; a colour match is not assumed.
We check the existing pavers and available replacements, then discuss the colour and layout for the repaired area.
zh: 旧铺砖匹配取决于供应及状况；不能默认颜色一致。
我们会检查现有铺砖及可选替换材料，与您讨论修复区域的颜色和铺排方式。

en: Preparation and compatible coatings form part of the assessment; painting over a damaged surface is not assumed to solve the underlying issue.
We check the timber and the cause of damage before confirming repairs, surface preparation and suitable coatings.
zh: 基层处理及兼容涂层属于评估内容；不会假定在受损表面刷漆便能解决根本问题。
我们会检查木材及损坏原因，再确认维修、基层处理和适合的涂层。

en: Keeping the original paint tin or colour reference can help identify the earlier product, but it cannot promise an invisible spot repair.
If you have the original paint tin or colour reference, we use it alongside the existing surface condition to plan the finish.
zh: 保留原漆罐或色号可帮助识别旧产品，但不能保证局部无痕。
如有原漆罐或色号，我们会结合现有表面状况规划饰面。

en: This avoids assuming a small patch includes an invisible match across aged paint.
We explain the preparation and painting area so you can choose the finish that suits the room.
zh: 避免假定小补块包含与旧漆完全无痕匹配。
我们会说明基层处理和涂刷区域，方便您选择适合房间的饰面方案。

en: That guide does not replace assessment of exterior masonry or continuing damp.
We inspect the exterior wall and any continuing damp before recommending repairs.
zh: 该指南不能替代对外部砖石或持续潮湿的评估。
我们会检查外墙及持续潮湿的部位，再说明维修方案。

en: Relevant qualifications and any required licences must be checked; regulated lock work is not assumed to be ordinary door fitting.
We check the product and installation requirements and assign our own appropriately licensed employees to regulated work within the agreed scope.
zh: 须核对相关资格及所需牌照；受监管锁具工作不能默认属于普通门安装。
我们会核对产品及安装要求，约定范围内的受监管工作由我们自有、具有相应执照的员工完成。

en: lock work may need a suitable specialist.
our own appropriately licensed employees carry out regulated lock work within the agreed scope.
zh: 锁具工作可能需要适当专业人员。
约定范围内的受监管锁具工作由我们自有、具有相应执照的员工完成。

en: A suburb match cannot establish the repair method or reserve an appointment.
Tell us your suburb and the repair needed; we confirm the assessment time and access arrangements with you.
zh: 城区匹配不能确定维修方法或预留预约。
请告诉我们所在城区及维修需求，我们会与您确认评估时间及进场安排。

en: General coverage does not confirm a particular appointment or travel time. The requested work, equipment, availability and safe access affect the arrangements for an individual property.
We discuss the work, equipment and property access with you, then confirm the available appointment time.
zh: 一般覆盖不代表已确认特定预约或行车时间。所需工作、设备、可约情况及安全进场条件影响具体房屋安排。
我们会与您讨论工作内容、所需设备及进场安排，再确认可预约的上门时间。

en: A search result or submitted request is not a confirmed booking.
After your enquiry, we contact you to confirm the visit details.
zh: 搜索结果或提交需求不代表预约已确认。
收到咨询后，我们会联系您确认到访详情。

en: A named suburb helps locate the property; it does not diagnose the fault or confirm a booking.
Give us your suburb and describe the fault so we can plan the assessment with you.
zh: 城区名称可定位房屋，不能诊断故障或确认预约。
请提供所在城区并描述故障，方便我们与您安排评估。

en: It helps determine location-specific coverage and which Ellis Perth team capability may be available.
We use your postcode and repair details to arrange the right team and confirm your appointment.
zh: 邮编有助确定具体地点覆盖范围，以及可能可用的 Ellis 珀斯团队能力。
我们会根据邮编和维修需求安排相应团队，并与您确认预约。

en: This hardware example does not establish fire-door, security-rated or locksmith work; describe those requirements separately.
For fire-rated or security doors and lock work, tell us the door type and product details so we can check the installation and licensing requirements.
zh: 本五金实例不能证明涉及防火门、防盗等级或锁匠工作；请分别描述这些要求。
涉及防火门、防盗门或锁具工作时，请说明门型及产品资料，我们会核对安装和持牌施工要求。

en: The region label identifies the general service area, rather than a precise property location.
We arrange local assessments for similar repairs.
zh: 区域名称表示大致服务范围，而非准确房屋位置。
我们会为类似维修安排本地评估。

en: The Perth office of Ellis Services Group, with a local handyman and maintenance team for direct property repairs and maintenance.
We are the Perth team at Ellis Services Group, providing property repairs and maintenance directly to our customers.
zh: Ellis Services Group 珀斯办事处设有本地维修与保养团队，直接提供物业维修及保养服务。
我们是 Ellis Services Group 珀斯团队，直接为客户提供房屋维修与日常保养服务。

en: The Ellis Perth office serves metropolitan Perth.
We serve metropolitan Perth.
zh: Ellis 珀斯办事处服务珀斯都会区。
我们服务珀斯都会区。

en: Ellis directly confirms
We directly confirm
zh: Ellis 直接确认
我们直接确认

en: Ellis Perth's own licensed personnel
our own licensed employees
zh: Ellis 自有持牌人员
我们的自有持牌员工

en: Our Perth office confirms the work details and next steps directly with the property contact.
We confirm the work details and next steps directly with the property contact.
zh: 珀斯办事处会直接与物业联系人确认工作细节和下一步安排。
我们会直接与物业联系人确认工作细节和下一步安排。

en: Ellis Perth is part of Ellis Services Group and operates as an independent Perth office with its own local handyman and maintenance team.
We are part of Ellis Services Group and operate from our Perth office with our own local handyman and maintenance team.
zh: Ellis 珀斯隶属 Ellis Services Group，以独立的珀斯办事处运营，拥有自己的本地维修与保养团队。
我们隶属 Ellis Services Group，在珀斯办事处设有自己的本地维修与保养团队。

en: Ellis Services Group provides its company registration identifiers here so customers can keep business details with their property enquiry.
We list our company registration details here for you to keep with your property enquiry.
zh: Ellis Services Group 在此提供公司注册识别信息，方便客户随物业咨询一同保存企业资料。
我们在这里列出公司注册资料，方便您随物业咨询一同保存。

en: Ellis's access
our access
zh: Ellis 的进场方式
我们的进场安排

en: This wall example does not establish the cause or repair method for a sagging or leaking ceiling; arrange a separate assessment for those concerns.
For a sagging or leaking ceiling, we assess the supports and source of water before confirming the repair plan.
zh: 本墙面实例不能确定下垂或漏水天花板的原因或维修方法；这些问题请另行安排评估。
如天花板下垂或漏水，我们会先检查支撑和水分来源，再确认维修方案。

en: Work at the clothesline mounting; the photograph does not reveal the concealed fixing arrangement.
Work in progress at the existing clothesline mounting.
zh: 晾衣架固定处施工；照片未显示隐蔽固定方式。
现有晾衣架固定处的维修过程。

en: The drawer after runner replacement; this view does not document intermediate fitting work.
The drawer refitted after replacement of the damaged runners.
zh: 滑轨更换后的抽屉；该画面未记录中间安装工作。
更换受损滑轨后复位的抽屉。

en: A level and shelf supports are visible during installation; concealed support details are not shown.
A level and shelf supports during installation.
zh: 安装中可见水平尺和搁板支撑，未显示隐蔽支撑细节。
搁板安装过程中的水平尺及支撑部件。
